mechanism: Prepare a fresh frozen grid using freeze_joint_grid(..., floor_odom_z_m=candidate); pass its planning_from_odom through existing configuration. No new missionflag or ROSparameter required.

runtime_effective.configuration.planning_from_odom: Fresh grid complete4x4; preserve declared XY/yaw construction, shape and new actual anchor

metadata_bindings.calibration.initialization_scope: fresh worker/actualcapture; no old fused researchmap or paid/semantic ledger

necessary_keys.do_not_add: configuration.floor_odom_z_m or configuration.input_geometry_profile: JointSession strictly rejects undeclared configuration keys. Profile/provenance belongs under calibration.
necessary_keys.important: Changing calibration.initial_grid.floor_odom_z_m alone is only metadata; actual effect requires matching configuration.planning_from_odom and newly bound observationpacket joint metadata.

single_variable.nominal_sensor_config: keep camera_height_m=.536 and laser_height_m=.684 unchanged for this diagnostic
other_preserved: scorer/candidate source, .35projection, headinggraph, cap and positive-option stop
real sensor depth/K/TF/ranges, actual missing data, ROS/hardware protections
single_variable.effect_boundary: Vertical inputframe translation changes depth occupancy, surface/asset heights and possibly future candidate/scoring outcomes. It is an explicit inputgeometry repair, not behavior-equivalent original evidence.

height_mismatch.assumption: base.z=0 for current planarCSM and legacy actual base_from_camera.z=.303, base_from_laser.z=.451
height_mismatch.scope: TF+candidatefloor derived values, not independently measured ground truth. If base.z differs, compute absolutefloor as currentactualbase.z plus frozen relativefloor; do not reuse odomorigin extrapolation after an epoch change.

matching_nominal_later.interpretation: Algebra/source can remain unchanged, but camera_pose and camera aperture/FOV/quality forecasts change. This is a separate declared prediction-geometry calibration variant and can alter decisions; not a metadata-only engineering fix.
matching_nominal_later.comparison: Keep initial single-variable trial separate. If later authorized, freeze a separately named height-matched profile before outcomes and apply identically across comparedmethods; preserve baseline mismatch results.
matching_nominal_later.laser_caveat: Matching nominal laserheight changes its declared model; scan-based actual fusion still uses its own actual historical TF. Do not assume all 2Dgain masks use height.

preservation: Keep existing configuration/report/workerledger/rawcapture/TSDF untouched; new uniquely named config/report/worker for this change.
Hash-copy oldconfiguration, candidatefitreceipt and newconfiguration; record a key-by-key diff limited to floor/frame/provenance and newidentity/resourceintent.
New actual packet must be captured/converted with the same fresh grid; do not edit or reuse old jointpacket metadata to falsely bind a changed transform.
Raw depth/K/world_from_camera/world_from_laser remain original odom measurements; apply planningframe transform exactly once in worker.
Do not import previous researchfusion/quality support, pendingactions or paidledger across this vertical frame change. An unchanged displayTSDF is separate from newresearchfusion.
Report method failures/return/CANzero and forecast/measurement mismatch; do not mark extrinsics or reconstruction accuracy independently verified.

source_refs.meaning: actualframe and scan use planning_from_odom times original historicalTF
